canonical_project: KIOST Ulsan Underwater Data Center Complex / Sinri Port Testbed
owner: Korea Institute of Ocean Science and Technology; Ulsan Metropolitan City; GS Engineering & Construction; POSCO
notes: DCD reported KIOST, Ulsan, GS E&C, and POSCO signed an agreement for eco-friendly underwater data center complex construction technology research targeting a seabed complex with 100,000 servers. The first underwater module/testbed is planned 30 m underwater off Sinri Port, Seosaeng-myeon, Ulju-gun.
